name: 11023 · Great Neck, NY
findings: ZIP 11023 (Great Neck) has 49 nonprofit organizations. 21 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 20 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 11023 (Great Neck) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
38% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 11023 (Great Neck) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.7 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 20 organizations here; 37% of all organizations here have no identified type.
